title: Anonymous visitor submits a missing event to the calendar
description: A logged-out visitor opens events.extrachill.com/submit/, fills in the public event submission form, and submits it. The submission must be admitted through the Turnstile-guarded extrachill/v1/event-submissions route, execute the extrachill/submit-event ability, and enqueue its Data Machine workflow, instead of failing with "Ability datamachine/execute-workflow does not have necessary permission" (extrachill-events#910). The grade checks what the REST route answered, what the visitor saw, the enqueued workflow job, and the submitter account attribution.
